evals.prompt: Refactor a shared button's Tailwind classes to support primary, secondary, loading, and disabled states. Use the project's existing class helper if one exists; otherwise add a typed cn helper with the appropriate dependencies. Keep focus visible and avoid dynamically interpolated class names.
evals.expected_output: A shared button implementation using existing Tailwind tokens and helper conventions, or a typed clsx/tailwind-merge cn helper when no helper exists, with object-based conditional class maps, complete interaction states, and static or intentionally safelisted utility classes.
expectations: Conditional classes use objects with class names as keys and boolean expressions as values.
Primary, secondary, loading, disabled, and focus-visible states are represented using existing theme tokens.
The implementation avoids unsafe dynamic utility interpolation and does not duplicate the class helper.
When no helper exists, cn uses clsx and tailwind-merge with direct dependency entries added through the project's existing package manager and a typed ClassValue signature.

evals.prompt: Fix a Tailwind-styled portaled select menu that is hidden behind the page header and loses its width and error styling. Keep the trigger accessible and preserve the project's Tailwind/Sass boundary.
evals.expected_output: A portal-aware styling fix that targets the rendered menu, stacking context, width, and error state without moving unrelated styles into a new global system.
expectations: The fix styles the portaled content rather than relying only on trigger ancestor styles.
Stacking order, menu width, and error/focus presentation are handled intentionally.
Existing Tailwind/Sass boundaries and accessibility behavior are preserved.
